attributes.action: Make full eclipses an annual occurrence in the UK and a Public Holiday.
attributes.additional_details: It’s about the eclipse, we need more of them.
attributes.background: Eclipses are an awesome phenomenon and it is unfair that Spain had a full one and we didn’t.  I want a full eclipse in the UK every year and for it to be a Public Holiday.

rejection.details: We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.
